normal.ask: Something small here glows. Can you find it and tap it?
normal.reply: There it is. Small things are easy to walk past.

longest.ask: Before you walk on, look carefully around this whole square, past the fountain and the statue, and find the one small light that does not belong to any lamp post.
longest.reply: That is the one. People have crossed this square for centuries and most of them never noticed it, so you can feel a little proud of yourself now.
longest.hint: It is lower than you think, about the height of your hand, and it moves a little as if it were breathing slowly.
